description: Static documentation site generator for Markdown, built on Svelte 5 and Vite: comment markers for components, live Svelte demos, Tailwind theming, Pagefind search, translations, versioned docs, generated API pages and llms.txt.
rules: Install svelte-edda as a dev dependency and run `svelte-edda dev`, `svelte-edda build` or `svelte-edda check`; the project does not need Svelte, Vite or SvelteKit of its own.
Before editing a project's docs run `npx svelte-edda guide`, which prints its syntax and components; afterwards run `npx svelte-edda check` and fix what it reports.

Pages are plain Markdown files in `docs/`. `sidebar` and `nav` in `svelte-edda.config.ts` order the menu, with groups `{ text, items }` and `{ text, dir }`; without `sidebar` the menu follows the folders, where a numeric prefix such as `10-` orders pages and is dropped from the URL.

Components are HTML comments around Markdown: `<!-- name attr="value" -->` … `<!-- /name -->`, or `<!-- name /-->` without content. Register them with `defineComponent` in `svelte-edda.config.ts`; every component gets the page language as the `lang` prop.

Tabs: `<!-- tabs -->`, then a bold label line such as `**npm**` before each variant, then `<!-- /tabs -->`. `<!-- cards -->` takes bold title lines the same way, `<!-- steps -->` one numbered list, `<!-- hero -->` a title, text and a paragraph of links.
Alerts use GitHub syntax: `> [!NOTE]`, `> [!TIP]`, `> [!IMPORTANT]`, `> [!WARNING]`, `> [!CAUTION]`. MDX tags, `:::` containers and `{% %}` tags are not read.
A ```svelte live``` code block renders as a working component; it can import packages but not relative files.
Restyle the theme with a CSS file passed as `css` that overrides Tailwind `@theme` tokens: the `--color-accent-*` and `--color-base-*` (gray) scales, `--font-sans`, `--font-mono`.

`generate` in the config runs tools such as TypeDoc into a folder of the docs, and `svelteComponents({ dir, components, exclude })` there writes props tables of Svelte 5 components; never edit files that carry `<!-- Generated, do not edit by hand.`, change their source instead.
